description:
The story takes place in Lingshan, where a group of "hopeless" people are gathered in the Earthly Realm. Most of them are poor, vicious, or extremely evil, abandoned by the society in Lingshan. This is where the fourth generation of Kuiba, Milin, was born.

The Heavenly Realm, having searched for Kuiba in vain, is determined to destroy Kuiba and blast the mountain to the ground. Milin rose from the predicament, and his spirit gradually awakened souls with flesh and blood in Lingshan. Milin led the Lingshan army to sweep across the world, against the Heavenly Realm, and became the overlord of the world.

(Source: QQ, translated)
